Domain message types and pure orchestration helpers. No imports from adapters or ports — only stdlib and core/types.

Example:

var h = newHistory()
doAssert h.len == 0

Imports

types

Types

ChatMessage = object
  role*: string              ## "user", "assistant", "system", or "tool"
  text*: string              ## Message content
  reasoning*: string         ## Optional chain-of-thought (DeepSeek, etc.)
  imageUrl*: string          ## Non-empty when message carries an image
  toolCalls*: seq[ToolCallRequest] ## Non-empty: assistant issued pending calls
  toolCallId*: string        ## Non-empty: this message is a tool result
Single message in a conversation history. Maps directly to LLM API message format. 
CompletionRequest = object
  system*: string            ## System prompt
  messages*: ConversationHistory ## Conversation so far
  maxTokens*: int            ## 0 = provider default
  tools*: seq[ToolDescription] ## Available tools
  reasoning*: bool           ## Enable Chain-of-Thought if supported
Request for LLM completion. Assembled from system prompt, history, and context. 
CompletionResponse = object
  text*: string              ## Generated content
  reasoning*: string         ## Optional chain-of-thought
  inputTokens*: int          ## Tokens consumed from prompt
  outputTokens*: int         ## Tokens generated
  toolCalls*: seq[ToolCallRequest] ## Tools requested by LLM
Response from LLM completion. Contains generated text, usage stats, and any tool calls. 
ConversationHistory = seq[ChatMessage]
Ordered list of messages forming a conversation context. 
InboundMessage = object
  userId*: UserId            ## Resolved user identity
  channelId*: string         ## Channel-specific message id (for ack/dedup)
  callbackId*: string        ## Non-empty for callback queries that need ack
  text*: string              ## Message content
  mediaUrl*: string          ## Non-empty when message has attachment
  channel*: ChannelKind      ## Source channel
Message received from a channel (Telegram, Discord, etc.). Produced by channel adapters, consumed by session manager. 
OutboundMessage = object
  userId*: UserId            ## Target user
  text*: string              ## Message content
  replyTo*: string           ## Channel-specific id to reply to (optional)
  channel*: ChannelKind      ## Destination channel
  streamId*: string          ## Non-empty for streaming turns
  isPartial*: bool           ## True for streaming partial edits
  mediaUrl*: string          ## Non-empty → send as photo/document
  keyboard*: seq[seq[(string, string)]] ## Inline keyboard buttons: [[("label","callback_data"),...],...]
Message to be sent to a channel. Created by session manager, sent by channel adapters. 
ToolCallRequest = object
  id*: string                ## Correlation ID for matching result
  name*: string              ## Tool name to invoke
  inputJson*: string         ## JSON-encoded arguments matching tool schema
Request from LLM to invoke a tool. Produced by provider adapters, dispatched by tool executor. 
ToolDescription = object
  name*: string              ## Tool name (alphanumeric, underscores)
  description*: string       ## Human-readable description for the LLM
  schemaJson*: string        ## JSON Schema for input validation
Schema for a callable tool (matches OpenAI function calling format). Used to register tools with LLM providers. 
ToolResultKind = enum
  trkOutput,                ## Normal successful output
  trkOperationalError        ## Infrastructure error (timeout, network, etc.)
Classification of tool execution result. Determines how the result is formatted for the LLM.

func addAssistant(h: var ConversationHistory; text: string; reasoning = "") {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Appends an assistant message to the history. Optionally includes chain-of-thought reasoning.

Example:

var h = newHistory()
h.addAssistant("Hi there!")
doAssert h.len == 1
doAssert h[0].role == "assistant"
